TRIAL_OFFER.title: Ancient Trial
TRIAL_OFFER.pages.INITIAL.description: Beside the embers of the last campfire stands an ancient altar. Silhouettes of the Chrysos Heirs flicker in the firelight, waiting for a challenger. Each heir's trial can only be attempted once per run.
TRIAL_OFFER.pages.CONFIRM.description: The Heir watches you in silence. Once begun, there is no turning back: the victor inherits a Resonance, the loser perishes here.
TRIAL_OFFER.pages.LEAVE.description: You quietly depart; the altar's fire dims behind you.
TRIAL_OFFER.pages.VICTORY.description: Trial passed. The Heir nods, leaving a Resonance upon the altar.
